countries.name: Singapore
countries.intro: Research master's and PhD funding is usually linked to admission. Check the school as well as the university: funding availability can differ by department.
countries.prepare: Match your research interests to a lab, prepare evidence of your thesis or projects, and check department-specific English and GRE requirements.

universities.name: National University of Singapore (NUS)
universities.requirements: Research Scholarship: at least second-class upper honours or equivalent; CV, statement and references. Check additional faculty requirements.

universities.name: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)
universities.requirements: Research Scholarship: Honours (Distinction) or equivalent. Submit a full-time research admission application; confirm that your school funds master's students.

awards.name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
awards.coverage: Tuition, stipend, and one-time airfare and settling-in support, subject to award terms.
awards.eligibility: International applicants with strong academic results, English communication skills and academic references. Intended for international students studying in Singapore for the first time.
awards.apply: Browse participating research projects, choose suitable supervisors and submit the SINGA online application.
awards.documents: Passport, transcripts and degree certificates in English, research interests, and referee reports; follow the portal checklist.
awards.timing: Check the intake-specific deadline on the official SINGA portal.

awards.name: NUS Research Scholarship
awards.coverage: Tuition waiver and stipend; international scholars have Graduate Assistantship Programme duties. Renewal depends on progress.
awards.eligibility: Open to international students, including Sri Lankans. Minimum academic prerequisite: second-class upper honours / honours distinction or equivalent.
awards.apply: Indicate scholarship interest within your NUS GradApp admission application; fulfil faculty requirements.
awards.documents: CV, statement of purpose, academic records and recommendation letters; tests and research evidence as required by the faculty.
awards.timing: Admission and scholarship deadlines depend on faculty and intake.

awards.name: NTU Research Scholarship
awards.coverage: Tuition support and stipend; normally up to two years for master's and four for PhD, subject to school funding and progress.
awards.eligibility: Local and international full-time research applicants with Honours (Distinction) or equivalent. Availability is school-specific.
awards.apply: Select scholarship interest in the admission application. Confirm your department's research and test requirements.
awards.documents: Academic certificates, transcripts, CV, references and required research / language materials.
awards.timing: Check the chosen school's intake deadline; admission does not guarantee funding.

countries.name: Japan
countries.intro: MEXT can support research leading to a master's or doctorate. A non-degree research placement does not itself guarantee admission to a degree or an extension of funding.
countries.prepare: Develop a focused research plan. For MEXT provisional acceptance, follow each university's stated contact procedure: some require an administrative office rather than a direct email to a professor.

universities.name: The University of Tokyo
universities.requirements: Graduate-school admission and MEXT procedures are separate. Follow the designated office for provisional acceptance; general university-recommendation recruitment is not expected, but special categories may remain.

universities.name: Kyoto University
universities.requirements: Degree applicants must pass the graduate school's entrance process. Check English-taught options and the Admissions Assistance Office process for provisional acceptance.

awards.name: MEXT Research Students · Sri Lanka route
awards.coverage: Tuition / admission fee exemption, stipend and eligible travel under MEXT rules.
awards.eligibility: Sri Lankan applicants must meet the current local notice and MEXT academic, age and field-of-study conditions.
awards.apply: Follow the Sri Lankan ministry's online call and local selection process. After first screening, request provisional acceptance using the host university's instructions.
awards.documents: Application, degree records, research plan, placement preferences, recommendations and medical form; use the annual checklist.
awards.timing: The Sri Lankan call for 2027 arrival closed on 18 May 2026. Check the ministry for the next call.
sources: Sri Lankan Ministry of Higher Education

awards.name: MEXT University Recommendation · Special Selection
awards.coverage: MEXT benefits for selected candidates; the programme and award conditions determine duration.
awards.eligibility: Applicants to an approved special programme who satisfy its admission and MEXT criteria. A general university-recommendation route should not be assumed available.
awards.apply: Find a currently eligible special programme, apply under its instructions and obtain the university's nomination.
awards.documents: Programme admission materials, academic records, language evidence and scholarship documents requested by that programme.
awards.timing: Programme-specific. Kyoto reports no general-programme recruitment for 2027; special selection has separate calls.

countries.name: China
countries.intro: Chinese Government Scholarships use different application routes. Type A normally goes through a home-country dispatching authority; Type B uses the university route. Full and partial awards both exist.
countries.prepare: Choose an English- or Chinese-taught programme first, check its language evidence, and keep the university application number and CSC application details consistent.

universities.name: Zhejiang University (ZJU)
universities.requirements: Meet the current master's or doctoral admission guide. Type B applicants must follow both ZJU and CSC procedures; check programme-specific supervisor and language requirements.

universities.name: Tsinghua University
universities.requirements: Meet your graduate department's entry criteria and scholarship process. Full CGS and tuition-only awards have different coverage; use the graduate financial-aid instructions.

awards.name: Chinese Government Scholarship · Type A
awards.coverage: Full or partial scholarship, depending on the bilateral award. Read the actual nomination notice.
awards.eligibility: Sri Lankan candidates satisfying the ministry / dispatching authority's current call and the chosen university's graduate requirements.
awards.apply: Apply through the dispatching authority specified in Sri Lanka's notice. Complete CSC and host-university steps when required; do not guess the agency number.
awards.documents: Degrees, transcripts, study or research plan, references, language evidence and any required medical / clearance documents.
awards.timing: Country nomination and university pre-admission deadlines can differ. Check the current Sri Lankan ministry call.
sources: Type A route explained by ZJU

awards.name: Chinese Government Scholarship · Type B
awards.coverage: For ZJU's full Chinese University Program: tuition waiver, accommodation support, stipend and medical insurance.
awards.eligibility: International applicants meeting the chosen university's graduate admission and scholarship conditions; programme exclusions may apply.
awards.apply: Follow the university's current Type B call and submit its application plus the CSC application as instructed.
awards.documents: Graduate admission file, research plan, recommendations, language proof and scholarship-specific forms.
awards.timing: University-specific; scholarship deadlines may be earlier than normal admission. The linked ZJU call describes the 2026 cycle.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.intro: Compare the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) with university funding. Embassy and university tracks have different submission rules, and GKS has an annual designated-university list.
countries.prepare: Allow time for certified academic and nationality documents. Check Korean / English language rules for the degree itself, even when a scholarship includes language training.

universities.name: KAIST
universities.requirements: Bachelor's or equivalent for master's / integrated entry; master's or equivalent for PhD. Meet the current international-citizenship and English-test or waiver rules.

universities.name: Seoul National University (SNU)
universities.requirements: Use the current international graduate admission guide and check GSFS eligibility and participating colleges. Scholarship selection is separate from admission.

awards.name: Global Korea Scholarship · Graduate (GKS-G)
awards.coverage: Government support under the annual GKS benefit schedule, including study and living support; check the current guidelines.
awards.eligibility: Sri Lankan candidates meeting the year's nationality, academic, age, health and degree requirements at a designated programme.
awards.apply: Choose Embassy Track or University Track under the annual rules. Sri Lanka's 2026 embassy call required BOTH online submission and one original certified hard-copy set.
awards.documents: GKS forms, personal statement / study plan, recommendations, nationality / family proof, degree records and required certifications.
awards.timing: Sri Lanka's 2026 embassy deadline was 25 February 2026, 2:30 pm Sri Lanka time; closed. Check the next notice.

awards.name: KAIST Scholarship
awards.coverage: Tuition coverage, health insurance and stipend; stipend arrangements depend on the college, award and research involvement.
awards.eligibility: International graduate applicants meeting KAIST's degree and language conditions. Some programme exclusions apply.
awards.apply: Choose KAIST Scholarship as the funding source in the graduate admission application. Eligible candidates are considered for relevant awards.
awards.documents: Academic records, statement, recommendations, nationality documentation and required English evidence.
awards.timing: Spring and fall admissions have separate rounds. Use the intake-specific admission schedule.

countries.name: Australia
countries.intro: Australia Awards is a Sri Lanka country programme. Research Training Program (RTP) and university research scholarships are a separate route for research master's and PhD applicants.
countries.prepare: For research degrees, document your thesis content and research contribution. For Australia Awards, connect your study plan to the current Sri Lanka priority fields and return-home development goals.

universities.name: University of Melbourne
universities.requirements: Apply for an eligible graduate research degree and meet its entry criteria. Stipend awards rank prior academic results and research potential; a course offer alone does not guarantee a stipend.

universities.name: Monash University
universities.requirements: PhD standard entry includes a relevant four-year research degree at honours IIA equivalent, or an eligible research master's. Research master's standard entry includes honours IIB equivalent, 65+; other assessed pathways exist.

awards.name: Australia Awards · Sri Lanka
awards.coverage: Award benefits can include tuition, living support, eligible travel and health cover under the country profile and policy handbook.
awards.eligibility: For the 2027 Sri Lanka call: an Australian bachelor's-equivalent qualification, relevant background and current employment with at least three years' post-qualification experience (sector-specific conditions apply). Meet English and other profile rules; return to Sri Lanka for two years.
awards.apply: Read the Sri Lanka country profile, check priority fields and apply online through OASIS using the official award process.
awards.documents: Certified academic / identity records, CV, Development Impact and Linkages Plan, English test, employment letter and prescribed referees. Research master's applicants also need a proposal and supervisor details.
awards.timing: The general 2027 intake round closed on 30 April 2026. Read the next Sri Lanka profile before applying.

awards.name: Research Training Program (RTP) / university research awards
awards.coverage: An award may provide a fee offset, stipend and/or allowances. Confirm tuition AND living support in the actual offer.
awards.eligibility: Domestic or international research-degree students at an eligible Australian university, meeting its admission and scholarship ranking criteria.
awards.apply: Apply to your chosen university, not the Australian education department. Follow its supervisor, admission and scholarship-round process.
awards.documents: CV, academic records, research proposal, evidence of thesis / publications, referees and English proof as required.
awards.timing: University scholarship rounds differ. Monash's international R1 2027 deadline is 28 February 2027; verify the faculty's instructions.

awards.name: Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarships
awards.coverage: For stipend-and-fee awards: tuition remission, living allowance, eligible relocation and single overseas-student health cover. Fee-only awards also exist.
awards.eligibility: High-achieving applicants who meet graduate research admission requirements. Stipend selection is competitive and depends on research potential.
awards.apply: New applicants applying for an eligible research course by its closing date are automatically considered.
awards.documents: The course application file, including required academic, research, referee and English evidence.
awards.timing: Use your course's scholarship consideration deadline. Admission and stipend decisions can arrive separately.

countries.name: United States (USA)
countries.intro: Compare a Sri Lanka-specific Fulbright master's award, university PhD funding and competitive graduate fellowships. A taught master's offer in the USA often needs a separate funding plan.
countries.prepare: Shortlist departments for academic fit, check degree equivalence and English / GRE rules, and request references early. Ask what the written funding offer covers and for how many years.

universities.name: Princeton University
universities.requirements: A recognised bachelor's degree by enrolment; programme-specific application and English requirements. PhD funding is guaranteed during regular enrolment, subject to academic conditions; master's funding varies.

universities.name: Stanford University
universities.requirements: Meet the selected graduate programme's entry rules. Knight-Hennessy needs a separate concurrent application and a qualifying first bachelor's graduation date.

awards.name: Fulbright Master's Awards · Sri Lanka
awards.study: Master's · up to two academic years
awards.coverage: Tuition / fees, living stipend, airfare and health insurance under the award; university cost-sharing may apply. Dependants are not funded.
awards.eligibility: Sri Lankan citizen; two years' continuous prior residence; qualifying four-year degree (or accepted equivalent / additional postgraduate qualification); at least one year of relevant full-time paid work. Further exclusions apply.
awards.apply: Use the US–Sri Lanka Fulbright Commission's official award page and linked IIE application.
awards.documents: Academic records, essays, references, work / residence evidence and required test materials; use the official instructions.
awards.timing: The page states 31 May annually; confirm the current competition. The listed 2027 cycle deadline has passed.
sources: Sri Lankan Fulbright eligibility and benefits

awards.name: University-funded PhD · Princeton example
awards.coverage: Princeton guarantees full PhD funding during regular programme enrolment. The mix of fellowship and assistantship support varies.
awards.eligibility: Applicants admitted to a degree-seeking PhD programme who meet academic and ongoing progress conditions.
awards.apply: Apply to the graduate programme by its deadline. Review the resulting financial support offer and any teaching or research duties.
awards.documents: Programme application, transcripts, statements, references and required test / work samples.
awards.timing: Department-specific annual admission deadlines. Do not assume master's programmes carry the same funding guarantee.

awards.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars · Stanford
awards.coverage: Graduate fellowship support under KHS terms. Confirm the funded duration and the degree programme's support for any additional years.
awards.eligibility: All nationalities may apply. For the 2027 cohort, the first bachelor's degree must normally be from January 2020 or later; exceptions and concurrent Stanford admission rules apply.
awards.apply: Submit separate KHS and Stanford graduate-degree applications aligned to the same entry year.
awards.documents: KHS essays / responses, CV, references and academic records, plus the separate department's admission file.
awards.timing: KHS and department deadlines are separate. Check the cohort's dates before preparing an application.

countries.name: Canada
countries.intro: Research master's and PhD funding often combines university awards, supervisor grants and assistantships. Check international eligibility for each award; Canadian citizenship restrictions differ across schemes.
countries.prepare: For thesis programmes, check whether you need a supervisor before applying. Compare the amount remaining after international tuition and fees, and the length of guaranteed support.

universities.name: University of British Columbia (UBC)
universities.requirements: Check credential-country equivalence and your programme's extra requirements. UBC Vancouver's PhD minimum funding policy is separate from admission and does not mean tuition is always additional.

universities.name: University of Waterloo
universities.requirements: Apply to a full-time research programme and meet departmental entry and supervisor requirements. International master's award nominations depend on faculty selection.

awards.name: UBC Vancouver PhD funding / Four Year Fellowship
awards.coverage: From September 2026, the minimum PhD package is CAD 40,000 annually for the first four years, subject to policy. It can combine awards and assistantships; check tuition treatment.
awards.eligibility: Eligible full-time UBC Vancouver PhD students. Four Year Fellowships are competitive and can include international recipients.
awards.apply: Apply to a PhD programme and check its funding offer. Ask the programme about fellowship nomination and departmental conditions.
awards.documents: Admission file, references, research statement and any supervisor / award materials requested.
awards.timing: Admission and internal award deadlines vary by programme. Check the current minimum-funding policy.

awards.name: Waterloo International Master's Award of Excellence
awards.coverage: Competitive additional funding for eligible international research master's students; not a stand-alone full-cost scholarship.
awards.eligibility: International students normally entering a research-based master's programme; faculty and academic conditions apply.
awards.apply: Apply for the research master's and ask your department about faculty nomination and your complete funding package.
awards.documents: Graduate application, transcripts, research interests and references; follow any faculty nomination instructions.
awards.timing: Programme-specific admission and award selection. Confirm the award's current value and duration.

countries.name: Europe · multi-country programmes
countries.intro: These routes span institutions and countries. Country-specific options follow below for the UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Sweden and Switzerland.
countries.prepare: For Erasmus Mundus, check the consortium's subject prerequisites and mobility plan. For a funded PhD vacancy, match your skills to the advertised project and read its mobility conditions.

universities.name: Erasmus Mundus participating universities
universities.requirements: A bachelor's degree, final-year status with graduation before entry, or an officially recognised equivalent; each consortium sets subject and language requirements.

universities.name: MSCA Doctoral Network host universities
universities.requirements: Apply to an advertised project, satisfy host doctoral admission and the network's mobility rule; candidates must not already hold a doctorate at recruitment.

awards.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
awards.coverage: Selected full scholarships cover participation costs and contribute to travel, visa and living costs.
awards.eligibility: Students worldwide, including Sri Lankans. Hold an eligible first degree or graduate before the course begins, and meet the consortium's prerequisites.
awards.apply: Choose a course from the official catalogue and apply directly to its consortium, following the scholarship instructions.
awards.documents: Academic records, motivation statement, references, language evidence and programme-specific materials.
awards.timing: Many applications fall between October and January for the next academic year; the individual course deadline controls.
sources: European Commission student guide and catalogue

awards.name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks
awards.coverage: Funded doctoral positions with remuneration / allowances under the project and host-country rules; read the specific vacancy.
awards.eligibility: Any nationality; no doctoral degree at recruitment. Normally, no more than 12 months of residence / main activity in the recruiting country during the preceding 36 months; read exceptions.
awards.apply: Apply to a funded network's advertised doctoral vacancy, including vacancies on EURAXESS. Individuals do not submit a network funding proposal.
awards.documents: Vacancy-specific CV, motivation letter, degrees / transcripts, references and research evidence.
awards.timing: Vacancy-specific throughout the year. Recruitment deadlines differ from the EU's institutional network call deadline.

countries.name: United Kingdom (UK)
countries.intro: Chevening and Commonwealth offer country-eligible routes; university awards such as Clarendon use separate selection rules. Check course and funding deadlines independently.
countries.prepare: For development-focused awards, explain the specific benefit to Sri Lanka. For PhD applications, build a research question and supervisor fit; for master's, explain course fit and career direction.

universities.name: University of Oxford
universities.requirements: Meet the chosen master's / DPhil entry criteria. Apply by the relevant December or January deadline for automatic Clarendon consideration; academic merit and potential drive selection.

universities.name: University of Cambridge
universities.requirements: Each course has its own academic, language and application requirements. Check its funding deadline early; master's and doctoral funding availability differ.

awards.name: Chevening · Sri Lanka
awards.coverage: Scholarship support under Chevening terms; check tuition conditions and any course-specific limits.
awards.eligibility: Eligible citizenship and residence, qualifying undergraduate degree, at least 2,800 hours of post-graduation work, and commitment to return home for two years.
awards.apply: Apply to Chevening and three eligible UK courses. Obtain an unconditional offer from at least one by the stated offer deadline.
awards.documents: Degree records, employment history, leadership / career responses, references and university admission materials.
awards.timing: The Sri Lanka page reports 2027/28 applications closed. Check the next cycle and its revised rules.

awards.name: Commonwealth Master's and PhD Scholarships
awards.coverage: Tuition and living / travel support under the relevant CSC scholarship terms.
awards.eligibility: Sri Lanka is an eligible country for the linked competitions. Academic, permanent-residence, financial-need and development-impact conditions apply; the master's and PhD rules differ.
awards.apply: Follow both CSC's online application and an approved nominating body's process. For Sri Lanka, check the current ministry nomination call and its separate deadline.
awards.documents: Identity and academic records, references, development-impact statements; PhD applicants also need the research and supervisor support specified in the call.
awards.timing: Annual competitions; check CSC and nominator deadlines separately. Old ministry notices are not current application calls.

awards.name: Clarendon Fund · Oxford
awards.coverage: Course fees and a living-expenses grant for the fee-liability period of the course.
awards.eligibility: All nationalities and fields; candidates for eligible new master's or DPhil courses selected for academic merit and potential.
awards.apply: Submit your Oxford graduate course application by its relevant December / January deadline. No separate Clarendon application.
awards.documents: Your complete course application and its required transcripts, references, statement / proposal, language evidence and work samples.
awards.timing: Use the course's funding deadline, not a later admission-only deadline.

countries.name: Germany
countries.intro: DAAD EPOS supports selected development-related postgraduate courses. Doctoral research can also be funded through a university or institute position; low tuition alone is not living-cost funding.
countries.prepare: For EPOS, assemble evidence of relevant work after your first degree and explain development impact. For PhDs, identify a supervisor or structured programme and verify how the position is funded.

universities.name: University of Stuttgart · WAREM example
universities.requirements: Check the Water Resources Engineering and Management course's relevant-degree, language and application requirements. Admission and a scholarship are separate decisions.

universities.name: German doctoral universities / research institutes
universities.requirements: Check the doctoral programme's degree equivalence, supervisor agreement and language rules. Use a current funded vacancy or a defined scholarship route.

awards.name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
awards.coverage: Scholarship benefits under the course and DAAD call; check any course fees and additional costs.
awards.eligibility: Eligible developing-country applicants, normally a relevant four-year bachelor's, upper-third results and at least two years' related post-degree work. Degrees should normally be no more than six years old.
awards.apply: Apply directly to an eligible EPOS course. Up to three course choices are allowed, with consistent priority order; do not send the initial application to DAAD.
awards.documents: DAAD forms, motivation, academic records, employer certificates, references and English / German proof.
awards.timing: Course-specific scholarship deadlines may be much earlier than self-funded admission. Exceptional doctoral EPOS routes require their own call.

awards.name: Funded German doctoral programmes and positions
awards.coverage: Depends on the actual position: an employment contract or scholarship. Check salary / stipend, hours, duration and remaining costs.
awards.eligibility: International candidates meeting the host university's doctoral entry requirements and the project's research criteria.
awards.apply: Find an advertised position or structured programme, or agree a project with an eligible supervisor and secure a defined funding source.
awards.documents: Academic CV, degree records, research proposal or project motivation, references and requested language / research evidence.
awards.timing: Each funded position or programme has its own application window.
sources: Official Research in Germany PhD guide

countries.name: France
countries.intro: Some major scholarships require nomination or invitation from a French university. Start with the degree application and the institution's internal scholarship deadline.
countries.prepare: Contact the programme's international office early. Confirm the language of teaching and whether tuition exemption applies; an allowance does not automatically cover all programme fees.

universities.name: Université Paris-Saclay
universities.requirements: For the international master's award: admission to an eligible master's, first-time French higher-education enrolment subject to exceptions, and under 30 in the application year. Programme coordinators invite candidates.

universities.name: French universities nominating for Eiffel
universities.requirements: Meet the host programme's admission and Eiffel's current age / field rules. The French institution must support and submit the scholarship application.

awards.name: France Excellence Eiffel
awards.study: Master's / engineering · eligible joint doctoral study
awards.coverage: Living allowance and specified services. Eiffel itself does not pay tuition; some qualifying public national-diploma programmes have fee exemptions. Confirm with the institution.
awards.eligibility: Foreign candidates in designated fields meeting the current age and academic rules; the host institution must nominate them.
awards.apply: Ask a French institution to support your candidature before its internal deadline. Only that institution submits to Campus France.
awards.documents: Academic records, CV, study / career plan and host-requested nomination file; doctoral applications need the required joint-supervision arrangements.
awards.timing: The university's internal deadline is earlier than Campus France's final submission date.

awards.name: Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarships
awards.coverage: EUR 10,000 per academic year plus travel / visa support up to the published limit. Payment starts after arrival and registration; budget for initial costs.
awards.eligibility: Outstanding admitted international students meeting first-enrolment, age and other-funding restrictions. Not all admitted students receive an invitation.
awards.apply: Apply for the master's first. Selected candidates receive an invitation to complete the scholarship form and arrange references.
awards.documents: Master's admission file and, if invited, scholarship responses and requested referee details.
awards.timing: Meet the programme and scholarship selection deadlines; late admission can miss scholarship consideration.

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.intro: Master's scholarships range from small contributions to substantial funding. Many PhD vacancies are paid university employment and are applied for as jobs.
countries.prepare: Compare tuition and living coverage separately. For PhD jobs, tailor the research evidence in your CV and cover letter to the advertised methods and project.

universities.name: Delft University of Technology · MSc
universities.requirements: Van Effen applicants need an eligible two-year regular MSc application and exceptional prior results; top 10% is an indication of competitiveness, not a required ranking certificate.

universities.name: Delft University of Technology · PhD
universities.requirements: Normally a relevant master's degree and suitability for an advertised research vacancy. Accepted vacancy candidates receive a salary under university employment terms.

awards.name: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
awards.study: TU Delft · eligible two-year regular MSc
awards.coverage: Full tuition plus a living-expenses contribution. Second-year continuation requires sufficient academic progress.
awards.eligibility: Excellent international applicants to eligible regular MSc programmes with relevant prior study; international joint education programmes are excluded.
awards.apply: Submit the complete MSc application, scholarship form, reference letter and English certificate or accepted exemption by the scholarship deadline.
awards.documents: Degree application file, scholarship form, reference and English evidence; use Delft's current checklist.
awards.timing: Published deadline: 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET (2 December, 04:29 Sri Lanka time). Verify the official call before submitting.
sources: TU Delft scholarship requirements and dates

awards.name: NL Scholarship
awards.coverage: EUR 5,000 in the first year. This is not a full-tuition or full-living-cost scholarship.
awards.eligibility: Non-EEA nationality, eligible full-time programme, institution-specific admission requirements, and no degree from a Dutch education institution.
awards.apply: Find participating universities and apply under the chosen institution's scholarship process.
awards.documents: University admission and scholarship file, with academic, language and motivation evidence as specified.
awards.timing: University-specific application dates. Check that the chosen programme participates in the current cycle.

awards.name: Paid PhD vacancies · TU Delft example
awards.coverage: Salary under the relevant Dutch universities' employment agreement for accepted PhD vacancy candidates.
awards.eligibility: Relevant master's degree and project-specific research qualifications, plus host doctoral admission conditions.
awards.apply: Use the university's advertised PhD vacancy and application instructions. A vacancy appointment and doctoral admission requirements both matter.
awards.documents: Targeted CV / cover letter, academic records, referees and research evidence requested in the vacancy.
awards.timing: Vacancy-specific; a general PhD information page is not an open job offer.
sources: TU Delft doctoral work and vacancies

countries.name: Sweden
countries.intro: University master's scholarships can cover tuition without living costs. Doctoral funding follows a separate recruitment process; also explore European MSCA vacancies at Swedish hosts.
countries.prepare: Complete the national master's admission process on time and check first-choice ranking rules. Build a separate living-cost plan when an award covers tuition only.

universities.name: Lund University
universities.requirements: Global Scholarship applicants must be non-EU/EEA fee-paying applicants with Lund as first choice; complete the degree application and pay the application fee before scholarship submission.

universities.name: KTH Royal Institute of Technology
universities.requirements: KTH Scholarship applicants must be fee-paying master's applicants who rank KTH first and pay the application fee. Academic excellence and sustainability motivation are assessed.

awards.name: Lund University Global Scholarship
awards.coverage: Part or all of tuition. Living costs are not included.
awards.eligibility: High-achieving fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland, with the eligible Lund programme ranked first.
awards.apply: Apply through universityadmissions.se and pay the fee, then complete Lund's separate scholarship application.
awards.documents: Admission documents and a separate scholarship motivation letter, maximum 600 words under current rules.
awards.timing: Usually a February scholarship round. The linked page's 2026 deadline has passed; verify the next dates.

awards.name: KTH Scholarship
awards.coverage: Full tuition for the eligible period, subject to progress. No living-cost support.
awards.eligibility: Fee-paying applicants with an eligible KTH programme as first priority and the application fee paid.
awards.apply: First apply to the master's via universityadmissions.se, then use KTH's scholarship form. Selection uses the submitted admission documents.
awards.documents: Complete national admission documents; the scholarship form does not require additional documents under the published rules.
awards.timing: Published scholarship window: 1 December 2026 to 15 January 2027. Check document deadlines and exact closing time on the official page.

awards.name: Paid doctoral positions at KTH
awards.coverage: Most KTH doctoral students are employed with a monthly salary. Follow the advertised position and appointment terms.
awards.eligibility: A relevant second-cycle degree, or qualifying credit-based / equivalent knowledge route, plus English and project-specific requirements. Admission to doctoral education is required for doctoral employment.
awards.apply: Apply to an advertised doctoral position through KTH's vacancy process, addressing the specific research topic and selection criteria.
awards.documents: Vacancy-specific academic CV, motivation, degrees and transcripts, references and relevant research evidence.
awards.timing: Each doctoral vacancy has its own closing date; the general doctoral guide is not a current job offer.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.intro: ETH's ESOP supports selected master's entrants. Swiss Government Excellence research funding and doctoral university appointments use separate eligibility and application processes.
countries.prepare: For research funding, find a suitable supervisor and write a specific project plan. For ESOP, prepare an original master's thesis pre-proposal and check whether an existing master's makes you ineligible.

universities.name: ETH Zurich
universities.requirements: ESOP needs a strong bachelor's record, master's admission application, thesis pre-proposal and references. Existing master's holders and students already enrolled in an ETH master's are ineligible for ESOP.

universities.name: EPFL
universities.requirements: Doctoral applicants normally have a relevant master's; some four-/five-year bachelor's holders may apply. Submit the programme file and three references; final enrolment needs a supervisor, topic and secure funding.

awards.name: ETH Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
awards.coverage: Tuition waiver plus study / living-expense support for the regular master's duration, under ESOP terms.
awards.eligibility: Outstanding eligible bachelor's graduates applying for an ETH master's. Those already holding a master's or enrolled in an ETH master's cannot apply.
awards.apply: Apply in the first master's application window and include the ESOP materials, especially an independently developed thesis pre-proposal.
awards.documents: Master's admission documents, thesis pre-proposal and two academic reference persons if the course does not already request references.
awards.timing: Published first window: 1–30 November. Verify the relevant entry-year call and exact deadline.

awards.name: Swiss Government Excellence · research / PhD
awards.coverage: Research living support under the 2027/28 terms. It is not an employment salary; confirm additional host funding and fees.
awards.eligibility: Normally a completed master's and a Swiss academic supervisor's support, plus age and country-specific conditions. Check Sri Lanka's country entry for available scholarship types.
awards.apply: Read the current country listing, secure supervisor backing and use the current GO ESKAS online instructions. Do not rely on older paper-submission guidance.
awards.documents: Research plan and timeline, supervisor support, academic records, motivation, references and the official checklist.
awards.timing: 2027/28 online access began 20 August 2026; the Sri Lanka country listing sets the closing date. No open-status claim is made here.
sources: Current country listings and online process

awards.name: EPFL funded doctoral appointment
awards.coverage: Funding through a laboratory appointment where offered; confirm the employment contract and doctoral programme conditions.
awards.eligibility: Applicants meeting the doctoral programme's academic requirements and selected for a compatible topic, supervisor and funded place.
awards.apply: Apply to the doctoral programme and pursue a suitable laboratory appointment. Programme acceptance alone is not final enrolment or a funding offer.
awards.documents: Degree records, statement of objectives, identity document and three electronically submitted references.
awards.timing: Doctoral programme deadlines and laboratory recruitment dates vary.
sources: EPFL doctoral admission and funding conditions
